name: Plaguebringer
description: A former Meridian utility engineer whose emerald field can drain the power from a city block.
biography:
Ivo Kest maintained Meridian's power lines from a lift that swayed in the wind between the towers. On the night the transit ring failed, he watched the city reroute power to the upper terraces while the pumps in the streets below went dark. By dawn, he knew which names had signed the order.

Ivo rebuilt his maintenance rig to draw power out of anything it touched. The first night he wore it, the lights went out one building at a time as he walked uphill. Meridian called him Plaguebringer after the outages began to spread. Lady Light found him at the base of the last lit tower, waiting for the people inside to come down.
